items.item_text: 01. Do you possess at least an Associate's degree from an accredited institution? Options: Yes | No

02. Do you have at least two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in student records, Registrar operations, higher education administration, records management, data processing, or a closely related area? Options: Yes | No
03. Do you have experience analyzing and processing detailed records, data, or documentation accurately and consistently? Options: Yes | No
04. Are you able to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive records and information and exercise appropriate discretion when handling such information? Options: Yes | No
05. The anticipated hiring salary for this position is $55,000 annually. Does this meet your salary expectations? Options: Yes | No
06. Are you available to work full-time on-site, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week? Options: Yes | No
07. Do you have legal authorization to work in the United States? Options: Yes | No
